results.title: Register with valid email + strong password
results.expected: Success message shown, form cleared

results.title: Register with plus-addressed / subdomain email
results.expected: Success message shown

results.title: Register with password at max valid length (64 chars, complex)
results.expected: Success message shown

results.title: Empty email
results.expected: Inline error "Email is required.", no success message

results.title: Empty password
results.expected: Inline error "Password is required.", no success message

results.title: Confirm password does not match
results.expected: Inline error "Passwords do not match.", no success message
results.actual: confirm error shown: "Passwords do not match."

results.title: Malformed email (missing @)
results.expected: Inline error "Please enter a valid email address."
results.actual: email error shown: "Please enter a valid email address."

results.title: Malformed email (missing domain suffix)
results.expected: Inline error "Please enter a valid email address."
results.actual: email error shown: "Please enter a valid email address."

results.title: Register with an already-registered email
results.expected: Form-level error "An account with this email already exists.", registration blocked
results.actual: Registration succeeded (success message shown) — duplicate email was NOT rejected.
results.error: Expected duplicate-email to be rejected with form-error, but registration succeeded instead.

results.title: Password missing special character
results.expected: Inline error "...at least one special character."
results.actual: password error shown: "Password must contain at least one special character."

results.title: Password missing uppercase letter
results.expected: Inline error "...at least one uppercase letter."
results.actual: password error shown: "Password must contain at least one uppercase letter."

results.title: Password missing digit
results.expected: Inline error "...at least one digit."
results.actual: password error shown: "Password must contain at least one digit."

results.title: Password exactly at minimum length (8 chars)
results.expected: Accepted — success message shown

results.title: Password one below minimum (7 chars)
results.expected: Rejected — "at least 8 characters" error
results.actual: 7-char password correctly rejected: "Password must be at least 8 characters long."

results.title: Password exactly at maximum length (64 chars)
results.expected: Accepted — success message shown

results.title: Password one above maximum (65 chars)
results.expected: Rejected — "at most 64 characters" error
results.actual: 65-char password correctly rejected: "Password must be at most 64 characters long."

results.title: Email at max allowed length (254 chars)
results.expected: Accepted — success message shown

results.title: Email whitespace is trimmed
results.expected: Treated as trimmed email; accepted

results.title: Password field masks input
results.expected: type="password" attribute present on password & confirm fields

results.title: Submit button disabled during submission (no double-submit)
results.expected: Button becomes disabled ("Creating account...") until request completes
results.actual: submit button correctly disabled during processing

results.title: Successful registration resets the form
results.expected: Email/password/confirm fields are empty after success
